description:
Control your Elgato lights with ease.


What’s new in Control Center 1.9.1?

💡 Key Light Air MK.2 Firmware Update
Firmware 1.1.11 brings three improvements to your Key Light Air MK.2:
- Color temperature is now more accurate.
- Stream Deck actions now control the right light when several are connected over USB, even if they were never set up on Wi-Fi.
- Special characters, such as umlauts, now stay in the device name.

🛠️ Improvements & bug fixes
- Added a warning, with tips on how to improve the signal, when pairing an accessory over a weak Wi-Fi or Bluetooth connection.
- The main window now opens faster from the tray icon.
- Fixed a crash that could occur when an accessory disconnected and reconnected.
- Fixed an issue where the installer could not continue when a custom install location on a drive other than C: was selected.
- Fixed an issue where silent installations failed with error 1603.
- Fixed an issue where low battery notifications for accessories appeared repeatedly, including while the accessory was charging.

Want to share feedback on Control Center 1.9.1? Connect with us:
- Leave a comment on our Subreddit
- Chat with fellow community members on Discord
- Hit up @elgato on X
- Discover more on Explorer
- Contact our Support Team
